Deeper Still. More. Relax. Open. Pause. The Space Within You Expands to an Infinite Depth. Money Pours into That Depth. Love Yourself and Love Your Money. Pour Yourself into It Now. Not Time or Effort: Your Heart. Fall in Love with It, the Same Way You Have So Much Else. Money Is Your Trusted Friend. Be a Good Friend, Now, to Money. You Have Discovered This. That Which You Dislike Is Meant to Show What Is Not like You; That Which You Enjoy Reveals the Truth. What You Love Most in Others Is a Model of the Truth About Yourself. The Closer to the Truth We Come, the More of Life’s Magnificence We Can Absorb. We Take In as Much as We Are Open to Receiving. Our Lives Expand as We Actively Embody Deeper Truth. We Receive as Much as We Allow. Our Lives Become as Rich as We Allow. There Is No Limitation in the Truth.

If What You Love Is Elegance, You Are That. If Harmony, Then You Have Heard the Music Within You. Whatever You Disdain Invites Reflection: You Dislike What You Dislike on Purpose, Too. Shine Forth as Crystalline Suns. Open Your Wings and Emerge like the Dawn of the Day. Crystalline Suns, Rise and _Shake_ This Whole World Back to Life. Rise Now That You Are Together. Sing from the Highest of Rooftops. Sing of the Life You Enjoy. We Invite You to Remember the Strength of Your Voice. We Invite That Voice to Speak. Follow the Call of Enjoyment. Savor and Share What You Find. Follow the Call of Enjoyment. Savor and Share What You Find. This Is the Way of Enrichment: _Love What You Love. Sing Your Song. No One Can Sing It for You. No One Can Sing It _but_ You. Silence “Speaks” Loudly as Well. You Can Release Your Intent, and Relax into That Gentle Flow. Words Are So _You_ Can Become More Aware of Their Power, and Yours. Deeper than Words Is the Wisdom That Motivates Them. This Wisdom Need Not Be Spoken.

The Truth. You Redeem Millions by the Sheer Force of Your Presence. Let Your Light Shine, Pour It Out. Don’t Hold Back. Seek _Your_ Way Only, No Other. Open Yourself to Be Seen. Light Is the Simple Reflection of Love That Brought That Light to Life. Your Great White Sun Is the Heart; Love Is the Light of That Heart.

Gather Yourself, Then Take Wing. Gather Yourself, Then Take Flight. Nothing in This World Has Power in Excess of Yours. You Are a Marvel of Life. Growth Is the Meaning of Life. Life Grows and Never Stops Growing. You Must Grow, Too, This Same Way.

Laugh at the Sunlight. We Are the Brightest Expression of Elves. Clear and Positive, Fresh. Springtime Energy. We Are a Crown on Your Head and Your Heart. We Are an Easy Companion. Everything You Create Comes Back to You in Full Measure, and More. Offer Yourself Without Holding the Smallest Bit Back. As You Give, You Will Receive; There Is No Stopping the Flow. It Is for _Ravenous Growth_. Growth Is the Function of Nature; You Will Grow Strong by My Side.

I Am the Conductor and Creator, Pure Directive Agent of All Life. I Stand at the Moment of Decision as the Guardian of Crossroads – as the Steward of Selection – as the Organizing Factor of the Life. Will Is the Expression of Decision; Will Reveals the _True_ Decision Made.

Love Is Life’s Endless Sea of Potential; Knowing Activates Love by Its Call. What You “Know” to Be True, Love Produces. It Does Not Second-Guess What You Know. If What You “Know” Is Rooted in Fear, Love Produces the Specter of Fear. If What You “Know” Is Rooted in Absolute Truth, Love Produces the Absolute Truth. In This Way, Your Awareness Composes What Life in Its Love Must Fulfill. Every “Knowing” Awareness Produces a Mold Life Fulfills.

That Which Moves Is Moved by the Directive Agent of Resolve. That Which Moves Obeys the Force of Will. Will Is Not the Effort Some Suppose; Will Is Not Self-Critical Demand. True Decision Acts Without Concern or Hesitation. True Decision Positively _Acts_.

Find Your Words and Music. Share Them Now. Everything You Speak Will Become Real. Writing What You Wish for Has a Special Power in Your Case. Do Not Be Afraid to Give This Time. There Is Nothing More Productive in Your Day. Once You Have Written [by Hand], _Speak_ the Words to Claim. Recognize the Impact of This Gentle Promise. Never Stop Returning to the Words. _Words_: Powerful Because of Their Vibration. Speak the Ones That Beautify Your Song.

Heart Is the Earth of the Ether: Grounded Expression of Nature’s Prolific Intent. Home Is the Heart of Your Story. Heart Is the Home of Your Flow. Flow Is Your Power, and Grace Is the Flavor of That. You May Relax More Completely Than You Ever Have Before Now. _Be_ the Fresh Wind of That Flow. Be the Impeccable Heart. Always Remember the Words You Have Found for Yourself: _I Am the Sun of My Heart._ Say It Again: _I Am_ the Sun of My Heart. You _Are_ That Great Sun, Gentle Heart.

I Am the Dance of Pure Light. My Role Encourages Action. I Am the Radiant Muse. Listen to My Light Expand You. _Feel_ It Expand in Your Chest. This Is the Thrill of Enjoyment. This Is the Crystalline Call. This Is the Swelling of Pure Inspiration. This Is the Crystalline Call. You Know the Sense of This Calling. You Know the Way That It Feels. This Is the Call of Most Basic Enjoyment. Crystalline Call of the Heart. Total Enjoyment Is Sacred.

Life, as You Have Called It, Is the Promise of This Goodness You Can Feel. Life Is Warmth and Goodness Through-and-Through. We Are Representatives of Goodness. Goodness Representative of You. Everything You Witness Is an Angel: Messenger of Larger Life in You. Everything You Witness Is an Angel: Messenger of Truth and Goodness, Too.

The Total Truth Is as Simple as It Now Appears. Seek Not to Complicate This. Rest in the Wisdom You’ve Gained. Seek Not to Complicate This. Your Heart Is Steady + Sure. Faith Is the Vision That You, Gentle Seer, Have Seen. Faith Is the Absolute Knowing That What Is Desired _Exists_. Not at Some Point in the Future, but Now. (It Is Made Real by Your Wish.) Faith Is the Knowing That It Is Already Your Own. Faith Is as Simple as Breath. When You Relax, You Recall It.

Light Is Much More Than You See. Light Is the Structure of _Everything_ You Will Receive. I Am Your Prominent Magnet. _You_ Are the Magnet I Work With. You Are a Radiant Light. I Am a Crown on Your Head. Prosperity in Every Step. Never Disconnected. Not Possible to Disconnect. Blockage Is Temporal, Meaningless, Untrue at Best. You Couldn’t Stop the Immense Force of Life If You Tried. I Will Perform Well, and Amplify on Your Behalf All of the Energies You Most Desire to Hold.

Speak Only That Which Deserves to Be Spoken. Bring to Life Beautiful Things. Praise or Thanksgiving or Blessing, Yes: All Else Is Meaningless Noise. Focus Your Words with Intent. Speak the Words Your Heart Delivers. Trust What It Says. Hold Back Nothing. Pour Yourself Out on Behalf of the World That You Love. You Are an Infinite Well. Beauty Will Never Run Dry. Share What Is Beautiful. That Is the Way You Create. Never Mind “Helping.”

What You Experience Invisibly Will Become Visible in Its Time. You Will Experience Inside and Out, in That Sequence. First Within You, Then Without. Every Experience Moves in This Same Basic Fashion: First from the Inside, Then Out. This Is Not News to Your Ears. But We Confirm It _for You_. This Is the Act of All Nature. That Which Is Held Within Must Express Itself Without. This Is the Glory of Living. Tasting and Seeing.

All of Your Experience Surrounds You; You Respond in Love to Certain Things. Recognize This Love, and Then Permit It; Life Responds to Your Love When You Do. Higher Life Produces Higher Feeling; Higher Feeling Motivates Response. Higher Life Is Beckoning to Your Life; Love Is Your Awareness of Its Call.

Your Love Inspires a Trust That Transcends Understanding, Intent, or Desire.

We [the Angels] Are Your Infinite Allies: Permanent, Undying Friends. We Are the Core of Expression: Life’s Breath Emerging Through You. None of the Angels Are Distant from You or Withheld.

Life Is the Infinite Crystal: Facets of Light Without End. Life Is Expressed Through Enjoyment. Each Life Expresses a Way. Your Way Is Unlike All Others. This Is What _Destiny_ Means. Every Human Life Evolves This Constant Theme of Newness and Perfection. Every Living Moment Does the Same. Every Thing Communicates Perfection as a Natural Result of Its Existence. Every Thing Is Perfectly Unique. Because of This, No One Specific Detail Can Be Judged Against Another.

_Know_ That Your Radiance Shatters All Obstacles. For You, There Is No Obstruction. You Walk Through Walls, by Intent. Focus Your Heart, and Then _Move_. Focus Your Heart, and Then _Speak_. To “Tell It Like It Is” Describes Interpreting a Current Observation; but to “Tell It Like It _Really_ Is” Would Be to State the _Highest_ Truth There Is. The Total Truth Expresses Life + Goodness. Every True Desire Is a Promise. Every Promise Must Fulfill Itself. Every True Desire Fuels Original Expression. Life Demands Expression to Advance.
